question: In Chapter 1045, Kaidou mentions "Comic Strips". Does that mean manga don't exist in the OP world? Eh!? Kaidou has never read One Piece?
answer: "Picture book" and "comic strips" appear in One Piece from time to time. "Picture book" is self-explanatory, but please think of "comic strips" as the "manga" of the OP world. Unlike manga, there is no concept of speech bubbles, so instead there are narrative boxes next to the art that have prose text and quotes from the characters. Famous comic strips include: Sora, Warrior of the Sea, Fire Dog, Pokeemon, Monkey Ball, and Maruko-san. There are all kinds out there.
